 New faces join ‘Young Sherlock’ as Prime Video expands cast for Season 2
 Date posted: 
 October 26, 2026 
 Prime Video has strengthened the ensemble cast for the second season of Young Sherlock, adding Sophie Skelton, Indira Varma, Olivia Williams and Aidan Gillen in key recurring roles as production moves forward on the mystery series.
 The new additions join returning star Hero Fiennes Tiffin, who reprises his role as the young Sherlock Holmes, alongside Dónal Finn as James Moriarty. The series, inspired by Andy Lane’s Young Sherlock Holmes novels, was renewed earlier this year following a strong debut for its first season.
 Although Prime Video has not yet revealed character details for the newly announced cast members, the additions bring an accomplished group of performers to the Guy Ritchie-produced drama. Ritchie, who directed the opening episodes of Season 1, is set to return to helm the premiere of Season 2, while creator and showrunner Matthew Parkhill continues to oversee the series. Returning cast members are also expected to include Zine Tseng, Joseph Fiennes, Max Irons, Natascha McElhone and Colin Firth.
 Set during Sherlock Holmes’ late teenage years, the series reimagines the iconic detective before he becomes the legendary investigator of Baker Street. The first season followed the gifted but impulsive 19-year-old as he navigated a murder investigation at Oxford, forging an unlikely bond with Moriarty while uncovering a broader conspiracy. Producers have said the story was conceived as a multi-season origin tale exploring how the future rivals evolve into the figures familiar to readers of Arthur Conan Doyle’s work.
 Amazon MGM Studios renewed the drama after its first season generated strong viewership and positive audience response. Executives have praised the creative team’s fresh take on Sherlock Holmes and the evolving relationship between Sherlock and Moriarty, while producers have indicated that future episodes will continue expanding the mythology introduced in Season 1. A premiere date for the second season has not yet been announced.
